say:1:1037007001:1.text: Corruption! There's terrible corruption ahead that turned the land black.
say:1:1037007001:1.source_cn: 污染！前面出现了可怕的污染，那污染会将土地变成黑色。

say:2:1037007002:1.text: And what's more, even gentle creatures nearby have gone insane!
say:2:1037007002:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，就连周围原本温顺的动物都会得狂躁。

say:3:1037007003:1.text: Go to Slopeville and hide. Don't put yourselves in danger.
say:3:1037007003:1.source_cn: 你们快去南坡村躲躲吧，不要让自己陷入危险之中。

say:4:1037007004:1.text: With the corruption spreading this way, perhaps I should go to Slopeville, too...
say:4:1037007004:1.source_cn: 现在污染正向着我这边蔓延……我要不要也搬回南坡村呢……
